Khi chọn căn hộ ven sông, anh chị nên ưu: When choosing a riverside apartment, you should prioritize three factors: a direct water view not blocked by future buildings, walking distance to the riverside route and piers, and the project's legal progress. These factors are more lasting than any “upgrade coming soon” news.
강변 아파트를 고를 때는 세 가지를 우선하십시오: 향후 건물에 가려지지 않는 정면 수변 조망, 강변 보행로와 선착장까지의 도보 거리, 프로젝트의 법적 진행 상황. 이 요소들은 어떤 “곧 개선” 소식보다 오래갑니다.
Lợi ích trực tiếp khi cảnh quan hai bờ s: The direct benefits when the Han River banks landscape is upgraded: better walkways and waterfront access, piers serving river tourism, and a more beautiful night landscape – an important factor for apartments rented to tourists. During construction, sections of the riverside roads may be temporarily fenced off.

Sông Hàn là “mặt tiền” của Đà Nẵng: pháo: The Han River is Da Nang's “front facade”: the international fireworks, the fire-breathing Dragon Bridge and night cruises all take place here. So every time the Han River banks landscape is upgraded, river-view apartments tend to get more attention from holiday renters and owner-occupiers. However, Hoang Hiep does not see this as a reason to chase prices: the project is only at the preparation stage, with no total investment or construction timeline for each area yet.
